purpose: bmcam000 vs bmcam003 power comparison over the last 10 h of common SD-card coverage; Wh per cycle from the bridge addr-65 trace.

sources.description: SPOT-31593C SD-card dump (hosts bmcam000); bridge node bm/0e582dd12c1e1480
SPOT-33507C SD-card dump (hosts bmcam003); bridge node bm/c3c564b91856226c

method_notes: Bridge addr-65 chosen per tools/bridge_energy_per_cycle.py design D9: dense on both units, reads the downstream camera load, drops to ~0 W in bus-off windows.
Cycle = complete bus-ON window (power > 0.05 W, gaps <= 90 s tolerated); partial windows at the span edges dropped (bmcam000: 2 dropped).
Halted-Pi baseline (~0.42-0.44 W) charged to the cycle deliberately.
Schedules measured from the trace: bmcam003 ~14.8 min on / 30 min period (15/15), bmcam000 ~19.8 min on / 30 min period (20/10).
